{{Top|leg}}
'''Medium freighter''' was a classification applied to certain [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] models. Medium freighters were by definition larger than a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], but smaller than a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]].<ref name="KO">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref>
